releaseName: Left-side Version Card and Supporter Scroll Improvements
message: Verdant 15.4.12 places the VERSION card left of PLAYERS and improves selection of the coloured supporter layout and top scrolling. Apply in Unity and test before publishing your VRChat world.
notes: Place VERSION on the left of PLAYERS with matching header styling.
Prefer supporter layouts containing the coloured membership tiers.
Retain the 15.4.11 Main Board and iPad distance-hide source patches.
Unity and UdonSharp runtime validation are still required.
